verses.1: My soul was filled with sorrow; my days were filled with grief. My bones became cold.
verses.2: If they do not stand with me, then my eyes will be fixed upon them.
verses.3: Please, let me be with you until evening. Who can help me in this situation?
verses.4: Because their hearts are filled with fear from the depths of their minds, they will not be able to cry out.
verses.5: He will divide his enemies among his children, and his sons’ eyes will be blinded.
verses.6: And I will be shown before the rulers of nations, and before their faces.
verses.7: And my eyes became blind, and my eyelids turned into scales like those of a fish.
verses.8: Let them be set aside by those who are righteous, and let them be pure on the other side.
verses.9: And the righteous will follow his path, and their hands will be pure.
verses.10: But let them all return. Please come back, and I won’t find any of you to be wise.
verses.11: The days have passed; my time has come to an end. My memories have been taken away from my heart.
verses.12: Throughout the night, cold light will shine from behind the darkness.
verses.13: If my house is in darkness, I will still follow my path.
verses.14: “My father, you are my father; you are my mother and my sister.”
verses.15: And who will hear my cries and my pleas? Who will listen to me?
verses.16: In the days of Shaul, they would descend together onto the mountain.
